units.source_text: 院子里的橘子树上堆满了雪，源氏公子召唤随从人，教他们将雪除去。

en.t: Snow had piled up on the orange tree in the garden, and Prince Genji called his attendants and told them to clear it away.

units.source_text: 那松树仿佛羡慕这橘子树，一根枝条自己翘了起来，于是白雪纷纷落下，

en.t: The pine tree seemed to envy the orange tree; one of its branches sprang up on its own, and the white snow came showering down,

units.source_text: 正有古歌中“天天白浪飞”[\[12\]](#part1335.html#m12)之趣。

en.t: just like the feeling of the old poem, "white waves fly day after day."[\[12\]](#part1335.html#m12)

units.source_text: 源氏公子望着，想道：“不须特别深解情趣的人，只要有普通一般程度的对象，也就好了。”

en.t: Prince Genji looked on and thought, "It would be enough to have someone of ordinary sensibility, not necessarily a person with an especially deep understanding of such elegance."
